svg.title: Coupling graphs of the four QPU twins
svg.desc: The coupling graphs the twins enforce, drawn from the packaged device data: complete graphs for the two trapped-ion processors and square lattices for the two superconducting processors, with the qubits and couplers of a 4-qubit GHZ chain highlighted.
svg.text: natives: gpi · gpi2 · rz · ms · zz
